new.hi: मानता है / आदर करता है, मान देता है
new.en: accepts, believes, regards as / honours, values

reason: Added the sense 'honours': a05.p8 ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੈ (he himself honours what he has made) and a06.p2 ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ (everyone honours you); our Hindi has आदर in both. 'regards as' added for ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ (a04.p4) and ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ (a23.p4). 'accepts, believes' kept (a03.p4, a04.p7, a05.p2, a18.p3) and put first as the commoner sense. Writer's मान करता है not used: in Hindi it reads as 'is proud, sulks'.

Added 'abode': in ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ (a01.rahao) and ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ (a24.p7) the Naam has its dwelling in the devotees' minds (our Hindi: बसता है / विश्राम करता है). 'rest, peace' kept and first (a02.p3, a11.p8).

Same sense missing as in ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ: a23.p1 ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ = its dwelling is in the body (our Hindi: विश्राम (ठिकाना)), and a02.p5 ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ (the Naam dwells in the saints' minds). 'rest, peace' kept (a14.p7, a20.p5); hi now gives शान्ति as the en already did.

new.hi: लगता है, छूता है / (सेवामें) लग जाता है, जुटता है
new.en: touches, strikes, clings to; seems / engages in, takes up (service)

reason: Added 'engages in': ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ (a03.p5) and ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ (a14.p7) = takes up the service (our Hindi: सेवामें लगे / लगता है). Added 'clings to' for ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਲਾ (a08.p2), ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ (a14.p1), ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ (a20.p1). 'touches, strikes' (obstacles, punishment, worry: a01.p2, a08.p1, a13.p4, a14.p1, a19.p3, a21.p6) and 'seems' kept.

new.hi: मूर्ख (लोग) / मूर्ख, मूढ़ (रे मन मूड़ = अरे मूर्ख मन)
new.en: fools / foolish (ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ = O foolish mind)

reason: en gave only the plural noun 'fools' though g already listed the adjective: a06.p7 ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ is an adjective qualifying the mind in address (O foolish mind; our Hindi अरे मूर्ख मन). a04.p2 ਮੂੜ ਅੰਧ = the blind fools keeps 'fools'. Senses now separated by ' / ' with g aligned.

new.en: half a letter, half a word

reason: Reviewer: hi आधा अक्षर and the parts (ਅਧ + ਅਖੵਰੁ, अक्षर) say half a letter/syllable, which en lacked. In a08.p7 (not even half a letter can be told of the Brahm Giani) both renderings fit, so 'half a word' is kept after 'half a letter'. One sense, not two, so no ' / '.

new.hi: मृग खानेवाले (सिंह, बाघ आदि हिंसक पशु)

reason: en lacked the lion that hi (सिंह) gives: Skt mṛgāśana, 'deer-eater', = a lion (Monier-Williams); Punjabi ਸ਼ੇਰ covers lion and tiger, so 'tigers, predators' is kept. Only line: a10.p4 ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ.

new.hi: बनकर, फबकर (बनि आई = फब गयी, मेल बन गया) / वनमें
new.en: becoming, befitting, suiting (ਬਨਿ ਆਈ = has come to suit, a bond has formed) / in the forest

reason: Merged review (a07.p3) and writer (a23.p2). (1) With ਆਈ/ਆਏ the verb means 'has come to suit, befits, a bond has formed': ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ (a07.p3), ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ (a07.p8), ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ (a14.p8), ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ (a22.p4); hi फबकर already had it, en had only 'becoming'. (2) ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ (a23.p2) is the locative of ਬਨੁ, 'in the forest' (our Hindi वनमें). 'becoming' kept.

a04.p7 ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੈ = revels in Maya's delights (kept, first). a07.p6 ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸੈ: our Hindi and translation take the verb (hearing and delighting), but Prof. Sahib Singh reads ਰਸੈ as 'from the tongue' (hearing from the Saadh's tongue; writer, doubts a07.p6), and Skt rasā = the tongue (Apte), so the line's second reading is added.

a09.p7 ਤੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ sets it against honour: the haughtiness or scorn others show him (our Hindi अपमान; Monier-Williams also has abhimāna 'intention to injure'). 'pride' kept and first: a03.p6, a05.p4, a07.p1, a12.p1, a12.p2, a15.p5.

new.hi: करनेवाला / सृष्टि, जगत् (करण कारण = जगत्‌का मूल)
new.en: doer / creation, what is made (ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ = the cause of creation)

reason: Only line a11.salok ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ: read both as 'doer and cause' (our Hindi; kept) and as 'the cause of the creation' (Sahib Singh: ਕਰਣ = the world; Skt karaṇa n. 'act, deed', Apte), which is how our new English renders it. The second reading is added.

The entry implied God only, with a capitalised 'Him' that our style (lower-case pronouns) does not use. Of 14 lines, 10 refer to God (a04.p2, a04.p3, a06.p1, a06.p2, a06.p4 x2, a06.p7, a13.p8, a15.p4, a22.p3), but four refer to a person: a12.p3 ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭਲਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ (the self-praising man), a14.p4 ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖ, a16.salok ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ, a16.p6 ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਭਲੀ.

Added 'renown': a12.p3 ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ = his spotless renown (Sahib Singh ਸੋਭਾ). 'that very (one)' kept (about 20 lines, e.g. a07.salok, a14.p1, a24.p5); 'sleeping' kept (a11.p6 ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੈ). Separators made ' / ' to match the three-part g.

new.hi: पाता है / डालता है, रखता है (ले पाछै पावै = लेकर पीछे डाल देता है) / पड़ता है (माइआ पाछै पावै = मायाके पीछे पड़ता है)
new.en: obtains / puts, places (ਲੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ = takes and puts behind him, forgets) / falls (ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ = runs after Maya)

reason: 'obtains' kept (21 of 23 lines). a12.p5 ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ = runs after Maya (from ਪੈਣਾ, falls; writer). The writer's '(with ਪਾਛੈ) chases after' would mislead in a05.p1 ਦਸ ਬਸਤੂ ਲੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ, where the same pair means 'puts (the ten gifts) behind him, forgets them' (our Hindi पीछे डाल देता है), so both are given, each with its phrase.

new.hi: धारण करता है (हृदयमें) / (सूत्रमें) टिकाये रखता है / (किसीको वैरी, मित्र) मानता है / (दया) करता है
new.en: enshrines / holds, sustains / holds (someone) as, regards as / bestows (mercy)

reason: 'enshrines' fits only ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ (a09.salok, a09.p5, a21.p5); kept, first. Added: a10.p3 ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਧਾਰੈ = holds all creation on his thread (writer); a12.p4 ਜਬ ਧਾਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤੁ = regards someone as enemy or friend (our Hindi मानता है); a17.p3 ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ = on whom God bestows mercy.
Only line a12.salok ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ: ਗਲਣਾ is to rot, waste away (hi गल गये); en gave only the figurative 'are consumed' (kept). One sense, so no ' / ' (the writer's proposal split it into two).

'enticing' dropped: it suggests temptation, and the only line, a07.p2 ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਬੈਨ, praises the words spoken in the Saadh's company (our Hindi वचन मनोहर; our translation 'pleasing'). ਮਨੋਹਰ = mind-stealing, so 'captivating' keeps that part of the sense.

The commonest sense was missing: the pronoun I in ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤੁ (a12.p1) and ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ (a12.p4). 'full of' (a04.p6 ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ) and 'in (all)' (a09.salok ਸਰਬ ਮੈ) kept. Separators made ' / ' to match g.

new.en: virtues, praises / qualities: (ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ) the three gunas of Maya — sattva, rajas, tamas

reason: Added the three gunas, needed in five lines: a07.p8 ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ, a16.salok ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ, a16.p3, a21.p6, a21.p7. 'virtues, praises' kept and first (a02.p8, a09.p5, a11.p2, a17.p1, a18.p4, a22.p3, a24.p7).

new.en: I hear, I listen; may I hear

reason: The -ਉ ending is first person singular (as already settled for ਕਰਉ); the imperative is ਸੁਨਹੁ / ਸੁਨਿ. The only line, a07.p7 ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ, goes on in the first person (ਹਮਾਰੀ), and our Hindi has सुनता हूँ. So सुनो / listen and the imperative g are dropped as wrong for the only line checked; सुनूँ kept.

new.g: आज्ञार्थ / क्रिया, वर्तमान, अन्य पुरुष / क्रिया, उत्तम पुरुष एकवचन

reason: Three uses: imperative 'sing' in a18.salok, a19.p6, a19.p8, a22.p5, a24.salok (kept, first); third person 'sings' in a06.p8 ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ (hi गाता है had it, en did not); first person 'I sing' in a07.p7, parallel to ਸੁਨਉ (our Hindi गाता हूँ).

new.en: astray, off the path; into desolation

reason: Reviewer: en lacked the sense hi gives first (कुमार्गपर). a13.p5 ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਈਐ = is led astray, off the path (our Hindi कुमार्गपर डाल दिया जाता है). 'into desolation' kept.
Added the singular: a13.p1 ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ = one's (own) place or station is defiled. 'places' kept and first: a03.p8 ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ, a05.p8 and a12.p7 ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ, a07.p5 ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ.

new.hi: टेढ़ा होता है / फिर जाता है, मुड़ जाता है

reason: ਭਵਣਾ (the root given) means to turn; the entry gave only the derived 'becomes twisted'. Only line a13.p2 ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ: read as the face becomes twisted (our Hindi, kept first) or as the face turns away (doubts a13.p2).
a19.p1 ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ = gather this wealth and become fortunate (our Hindi भाग्यवान बनो; Skt bhagavat 'fortunate'). 'the Lord God' kept: a04.p8, a09.p3 (three times), a19.p8, a23.p2.

new.hi: स्थानपर, ठौर (सभ ठाइ = सब स्थानोंमें) / (आवै ठाइ) ठिकाने, स्थिर
new.en: in a place, at the place (ਸਭ ਠਾਇ = in every place) / (ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ) to its place, at rest

reason: ਠਾਇ is the singular locative of ਠਾਉ, so the plural 'in places' was wrong (ਸਭ ਠਾਇ, a16.p4, is 'in every place'; ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ, a21.p2, 'in what place'); the sense is kept as 'in a place'. Added a19.p3 ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ = the wandering mind comes back to its place, to rest (our Hindi ठिकाने आ जाता है).

new.hi: भाई / हे भाई / भायी, अच्छी लगी
new.en: brother / O brother / pleased, was pleasing (to)

reason: Added the verb: a20.p8 ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ = the telling of the Name is pleasing to the mind (past fem. of ਭਾਉਣਾ), not 'brother'. 'brother' (a02.p1, a21.p5) and the address (a07.p8, a18.p7) kept; 'O sibling' made 'O brother', since ਭਾਈ is masculine. g and r now give all three senses.
a21.salok ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ = he himself in turn meditates on himself (our Hindi जपता है): present, third person. Imperative 'chant' kept and first: a12.p5, a15.p1, a19.p8.

new.en: he (did), that one / in the grass, in a blade of grass

reason: a23.p2 ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ = in forest, grass and mountain: the locative of ਤਿਣੁ (Skt tṛṇa), not the pronoun (our Hindi तिनकेमें). The pronoun 'he (did)' kept and first: a01.p8, a03.p6, a05.p1, a09.p6, a10.p6, a17.p2, a18.p7, a20.p3, a23.p1.
a23.p7 ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ describes God, blended through and through with his creation (our Hindi रचा हुआ है), not a command. Imperative kept and first: a06.p7 ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ.

Added the singular: a24.p5 ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ = that person becomes a treasure-house; also God as ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ (a16.p1) and ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ (a22.p2), the treasure of mercy, of virtues. The writer's '(of virtues)' is left out because it fits only some of these lines. 'treasures' kept and first: a01.p2, a06.p8, a14.p8, a15.p7, a18.p3, a19.p2 (ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ).
